name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Soul of the Serpent) — 1 Basic — Serpentine Sense

system.description:
The Thaumaturge accesses the considerable olfactory prowess of the serpent, granting acute sensitivity to all smells for the duration of the scene. She can identify poisons and poisoned foods by smell, and can effectively "see" through supernatural darkness (such as that created by Obtenebration), which imposes only a minor penalty on her rather than blinding her outright.

System: Supernatural darkness imposes only a one-Trait penalty to actions taken within its area of effect while this power is active, rather than blinding the character. Using this power also dulls the character's hearing for its duration.
